meta: How to write a clear job ad with AI for a small shop: a vague ad gets everyone applying while the right people scroll past.

muc.title: A vague job ad
muc.text: An ad that only says "looking for someone quick" gets everyone applying while the right people scroll past. A clear ad saves time.

muc.title: Five must-haves
muc.text: A good ad has five things: daily tasks, hours, pay range, address and how to apply.

muc.title: Skills, not age
muc.text: Don't limit age, gender or hometown. List the skills needed instead, like basic drink-making or using a cash register.

muc.title: Let AI review the ad
muc.text: After drafting, ask a chatbot to flag vague parts and anything that could be discriminatory, then shorten it to post.

muc.title: An eight-line job ad
muc.text: Describe the job your shop needs filled and ask a chatbot for a job ad with all five items, under eight lines.
